purpose: 챔피언스리그 전용 트로피 및 플레이어 명함 진열 디자인
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a premium transparent inventory trophy illustration for a Korean fantasy competitive game, shown in a Champions League tournament hero and in a player calling-card trophy cabinet.
Primary request: design ONE new, exceptionally prestigious CHAMPIONS LEAGUE winner's trophy. Full original trophy, not any real sports organization's cup or logo.
Subject: a tall sculptural platinum-silver cup with two dramatically ascending, sweeping open handles that frame the bowl like refined victory wings; thick clean sweeping surfaces with restrained champagne-gold edge inlay. In the center of the upper bowl sits a brilliant cool sapphire-blue faceted crystal held by three elegant silver prongs, an integrated crown-like summit. The tall central body narrows gracefully into a short stem. A substantial low stepped polished obsidian base with a fine gold edge anchors the silhouette. Use minimal large-scale geometric engraving, with one abstract three-ray insignia, NO words.
Style: beautifully painted, high-end 2D game item art with convincing precious-metal reflections and crystal refraction, polished edges, sophisticated crafted forms, strong elegant silhouette. Platinum is the main material, gold a restrained accent, crystal a saturated ice blue focal point. This should feel more exclusive and majestic than a regular gold cup. No gritty metal wear, no excessive tiny filigree.
Composition: one complete trophy centered on square canvas, nearly frontal slight elevated three-quarter view so top bowl is readable, symmetric and monumental. Trophy occupies 86% of canvas height and about 70% width, fully visible top to base. Clean cutout silhouette with holes between handles and bowl transparent. Sharp enough to read at 96 pixels and luxurious at 320 pixels. Balanced width, large handles, avoid needle-thin pieces.
Lighting: broad ivory highlights from upper left and subtle cool blue reflection from crystal, controlled luminous reflections inside crystal only; no painted fog, no outer glow halo.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background. No floor, no cast shadow outside trophy, no environment, no extra objects, no frame, no border, no text, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no soccer ball, no logo. The dark base and full metal object must remain opaque. Output a single high-resolution square RGBA PNG.
processing: Original PNG copied without edits; transparent 512 × 512 WebP export via Sharp (quality 92, alphaQuality 100, effort 6).
